traits.compact_full_field: One mostly contiguous play region with limited internal separation.
traits.split_regions: Two or more visibly disconnected play regions.
traits.layered_bands: The board is organized into distinct horizontal or vertical layers.
traits.edge_channels: Playable cells form narrow routes along one or more outer edges.
traits.central_mass: A large blocker or covered region dominates the board center.
traits.open_center: The central area is visibly empty while play regions surround it.
traits.stair_step: The playable boundary follows a stepped or diagonal progression.
traits.asymmetric: The major left and right board regions do not mirror each other.
